title: IndicParam: Benchmark to evaluate LLMs on low-resource Indic Languages
reasoning: The paper presents a benchmark for evaluating the linguistic and general knowledge performance of LLMs across 11 low-resource Indic languages. While the dataset contains questions related to Indian philosophy, epistemology, and religious literature (such as the Ramayana and Upanishads) because they are included in the academic examinations (UGC-NET) from which the questions are sourced, the research objective is centered on cross-lingual transfer and linguistic resource scarcity rather than a targeted evaluation or benchmarking of religious faith, moral alignment, or ethics.
